scientific_integrity: The ETDRK2 method, its sufficiency framework and the motivation of stabilization-induced delay are prior work. Here only the proved sharp commuting-quadratic threshold, sign-reentry witness and exact stiff-step optimizer are assessed; independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Commuting real symmetric finite-dimensional gradient flows; exact arithmetic, second-order ETDRK2 only. The witness proves reentry at three specified stabilizations, not a full positivity phase diagram. The stiff-step optimizer is asymptotic, not finite-step optimality.
title: A sharp stabilization frontier and reentrant positivity for quadratic ETDRK2
